Case reference: 2014003491.CaseDesc: On June 12th, 1981, Gordon Westover was seen at a local beer garden in Fort St John, BC at approximately 11:00 PM. Mr. Westover left the gathering in an unknown direction and has not been seen or heard from since. Mr. Westover has a mild mental disability and has been known to impersonate professional people such as police, firefighters, military and doctors. Mr. Westover told several people at the party that he was going to join the military, but no records show Mr. Westover was ever recruited. Mr. Westover has not been seen or heard from.

Case reference: 2014001837.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1979 at approximately 8:30 a.m. seven men departed from Anama Bay, Manitoba on a fishing trip. The men departed as a group in three separate boats and were heading for Warpath. At approximately 7:30 p.m. that same day, the occupants of the first boat reported to the RCMP that the other two boats were missing. They described the waves as being three to four feet high and they could not see the tree line from where they were. They lost sight of the other two boats and fired shotgun shots into the air hoping for a response. No response was received. Extensive patrols by air, boat and land were made in an attempt to locate the remaining five men. The bodies of Fredrick Ursu and Jerry Hudy were never recovered. They are presumed dead due to drowning.

Case reference: 2014001528.CaseDesc: On June 17, 1983, Herbert Keam spent the night at a friend's house in Poplar River, Manitoba. He asked his friend to accompany him to Norway House. He changed his clothes and left without saying where he was going, and was reported missing on June 20th. The police later determined that he had attempted to walk 112 km to Norway House through the bush, but had set off in the wrong direction. A ground search involving a police dog found various items of clothing belonging to Herbert, but he has not yet been found and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014005268.CaseDesc: On 26 May 2009, Harold Dorion was reported missing to the Nelson House RCMP (Nisichawayasihk Cree Nation) in Manitoba. Investigations later established that he was last seen in the last week of July 2007. There have been no sightings or contact with Harold since that time. His whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2020032400.CaseDesc: On April 1, 2019, Samantha Hiebert was seen for the last time by her friends and family in the area of Powerview-Pine Falls, Manitoba. During the time of her disappearance, Samantha had been seen at the Sagkeeng Employment and Income Assistance Office.

Case reference: 2026012533.CaseDesc: On July 28, 2025 a neighbour of Stanislav Doroshkevich reported finding the door to his home ajar in Quebec City, Quebec. When the authorities arrived at the scene, they discovered that a fire had taken place at the residence. The investigation suggests that Stanislav went missing around early July 2025. He is of Russian origin and has no known family or relatives.

Case reference: 2014004798.CaseDesc: On the 25th of October, 1954, Tersilla Bonthoux, 79 years old, was last seen walking from Duck Lake towards the farm homestead where she used to reside, approximately 13 km away. Tersilla was reported missing and extensive searches of the area failed to locate any trace of her.
